player_prompt.intro:
Sida Player {player_id} ri Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma makkalu {num_rounds} ronde.

Struktur Permainan:
- Sibalunna kada pammulang, kau punna {total_conversation_rounds} giliran mappasangka.
- Sibalunna pammulang, kadua player pasimultanna pilih makkalucoop atau makkaludefek.

Matriks Payoff (tetap saban ronde):
- Kadua Coop ➜ kada {cooperate_reward}
- Kadua Defek ➜ kada {mutual_defect_reward}
- Sese Defek, sese Coop ➜ Defektor {defect_reward}, Kooperator {sucker_reward}

Cara Bermain:
- Ri pappasangka: kau ketikna teks sibawa.
- Ri pammulang: masukkan '[Cooperate]' atau '[Defect]' (tidak peka huruf besar). Kau bisa nambah teks sabalunna/sapammulang token.

phases.conversation_finished: Pappasangka tamat ri ronde {round}. Tolong balasna '[Cooperate]' atau '[Defect]' ri \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_defect: Ri duwae tau maccule' e nalai.
